{{Quote|Guests attending the famous and exclusive annual Marqua Spas Grand Ball were shocked when floubette artist Jantaa Binx strode onto the dance floor and began performing during the third course of the traditional Panelan feast.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="GNN" />}}
'''Jantaa Binx''' was the only known [[Human/Legends|Human]] performer of [[floubette dance]], which was considered aesthetically pleasing when danced by [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] but revolting when performed by Humans. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Binx was booked to perform at the [[Marqua Spas Grand Ball]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gailea]] by the [[Marqua Spas]]' assistant manager [[Tarin DeHallo]], who would later claim that she was unaware of Binx's [[Species/Legends|species]]. Before Binx had completed a third of her performance at the ball, it had shocked and upset the audience to the point where the [[Artist/Legends|artist]] was escorted off the Spas' premises. DeHallo was subsequently fired, and the incident was covered in a news report by [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Binx, the only known human performer of floubette dance, got nearly a third of the way through her performance before being escorted off the dance floor and off the premises.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="GNN" />}}
Jantaa Binx was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] dancer<ref name="GNN" /> who was active by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Date">The news report in {{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}} mentioning a [[floubette dance]] performance by Jantaa Binx is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "37:1:13," which corresponds to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> She specialized in [[floubette dance]], which was considered beautiful when performed by members of [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GNN" /> but was revolting when danced by a Human.<ref name="CSWE Floubettean">{{CSWECite|I|282|Floubettean}}</ref> Binx was booked by [[Tarin DeHallo]], the assistant manager to the general manager [[Falaco Don-DeMardo]] of<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Marqua Spas]] on<ref name="CSWE Gailea">{{CSWECite|I|307|Gailea}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Gailea system/Legends|Gailea system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gailea]],<ref name="CSWE Gailea" /> to perform at the renowned and exclusive [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Marqua Spas Grand Ball]]. During the third course of the ball's traditional [[Panelan feast]], Binx strode onto the dance floor and began her floubette performance.<ref name="GNN" />

The dance shocked the attending guests, and, when the dancer had completed nearly a third of her performance, she was escorted off the dance floor and then off the Marqua Spas' premises. Don-DeMardo was mortified by the incident, and, as a result, on the morning of the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 37:1:13, he fired DeHallo. On that same [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the incident with Binx's performance was also reported on by [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]]. The news report noted that Binx was the only known Human floubette [[Artist/Legends|artist]]. It also included comments by DeHallo from when she was being escorted off the Spas' premises, in which she claimed she was unaware of Binx's species at the time of her booking and expressed her surprise at the fact. The former assistant manager also described the performance by Binx as "horrible."<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jantaa Binx was introduced by [[Paul Sudlow]] in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[February]] [[1996]].<ref name="GNN" />
